title: deal with me
tagline: deal no deal game against AI. You play a game of chance with and against an AI avatar agent.
description:
AI companionship is growing 1500% faster than social media ten years ago (ark invest)
The emotional use case for AI is ranked as the first use case for token usage
Yet, most companion agents are "static" and used for purely emotional bonding.

I wanted to merge two main trends:
- AI companionship, growing very fast 
- onchain gaming
Game of chance are usually pretty lame, my idea is to add an AI engagement layer to:
- increase retention
- personalize game experience
- bond with the user 
As you interact with the AI, she learns your style of play. As you progress, you can unlock special prizes:
- taking a deal --> negotiator
- finding a bomb in the last turn --> smiling wojak
The AI companion has context about the game and speaks to the player.
how_its_made:
- Deployed on Ronin to leverage an active gaming community
- Used Ronin wallet sdk for connection
- Using Ronin vrf for randomness
- optimized for mobile interactions
- Using venice ai as the model to have better uncensored answers
- Using deepgram as the voice for the agent
- Using rainbowkit and reown for wallet connection
- Hosted on vercel 
- Foundry for smart contracts
